attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his December 2024 newsletter, stated in his own voice.

semantics.note: Keeps 'almost every' and 'deeply unprofitable'. The second clause looks forward and is vague, but the core of the claim is a present-tense observation about profitability.

contract.note: Reading the claim as chiefly OpenAI and Anthropic over calendar 2024, with a few exceptions allowed, is an ordinary plain reading. Leaving the vague second clause unscored is fair. The set of companies is narrow but not stretched.

evidence.note: A contemporaneous 2024 projection: about $5B loss on $3.7B revenue for OpenAI. The contract accepts projections.
Reuters, via Wolf Street, on the prospectus: Anthropic's 2024 net loss was $8B. Published before the evaluation date.
S-1 coverage giving Anthropic's 2024 revenue as $386M, which shows how deep the loss was. The 2026 operating profit falls in a later period.
Midjourney was reported profitable in 2023, a different period. At most a single exception, which 'almost every' allows.

reviews.rationale: In 2024 the two most prominent model makers lost far more than their revenue: OpenAI about $5B on $3.7B, Anthropic $8B on $386M. The only exception found, Midjourney, fits 'almost every'. Other firms' results are not in the packet, so coverage is thin, but the contract's support condition is met. The second clause is not scored.

attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his December 2024 newsletter.

semantics.note: The normalisation is faithful but leaves out the rhetorical 'nobody can really describe'. The core is an observation built on evaluative terms that cannot be tested.

contract.note: 'Killer app' and 'industry-defining' have no measure the speaker supplied, and no ordinary reading settles them. Not scoring the claim is fair.

evidence.note: OpenAI's projected 2024 loss of about $5B backs the 'burns billions' sub-claim at the company level. It does not bear on the killer-app core.

reviews.rationale: The main claim, that no generative AI product other than ChatGPT is a killer app, is a value judgment with no measurable threshold. The 'burns billions' part is consistent with OpenAI's reported losses, but that does not settle the main claim. Not scored.
